title: Concept: macOS .DS_Store metadata served from the web root
description: .DS_Store records the names of every entry in its directory, including files that are no longer linked. Serving it therefore restores a directory listing the server was configured to hide, and the file is routinely shipped by a build that copied a working tree.
applicability: Responses served from a document root that was populated from a developer machine.
risk: The caller recovers the names of unlinked or deleted files, which often include backups, configuration and staging artefacts.
